claim_text: The Anwar Adow information alleges that, based on inflated and fraudulent claims, Liberty Plus received more than $1.2 million in Medicaid funds for services purportedly provided to approximately 200 beneficiaries. That figure is alleged amount paid to the provider, not proven_loss, and must not be added to the paragraph-8 program-wide HSS payouts or to Feeding Our Future charged amounts.

supporting_passages.quote: Ultimately, based on inflated and fraudulent claims, Liberty Plus received more than $1.2 million in Medicaid funds for services purportedly provided to approximately 200 beneficiaries.
